author: Eclimn
developer_reply:
Hello, it is possible to set a start date in the past.

For auto streaks, edit the start date in the streak's history.

If you want to do a manual streak, you can use the calendar to select past days and check them.
For longer streaks this might not be ideal indeed. We can work on a better solution.

Best regards,
Luc from StreakUp

text: Great design, but the logic feels backwards. The streak shouldn't increase automatically; it should only go up when I manually validate the task. Right now, if I forget the app, the counter keeps growing, so there’s no sense of achievement. It would be much more rewarding to 'earn' the flame each day and have it reset automatically if I fail to check in. With this inverted feature, it would be a 5/5
